d: We are hiring a Compliance Officer to be our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO). You will run our anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing programme as a regulated corporate service provider in the UAE.
Review every new client before we take them on: identity, ownership, source of funds and risk rating, with enhanced due diligence where the risk calls for it.
Screen clients and their owners against UN, UAE and other sanctions lists, and decide on any match.
File suspicious transaction and activity reports on goAML and keep our registration current.
Keep our AML policy, business risk assessment and procedures in line with UAE law.
Train the team and check the rules are followed day to day.
Be our contact with the supervising Ministry and the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit.
3+ years of AML compliance work in the UAE, ideally at a corporate service provider, bank, law firm or audit firm.
Sound knowledge of UAE AML rules for designated non-financial businesses and professions (DNFBPs).
CAMS, ICA or a similar qualification is a plus.
UAE residence, or the ability to get it.
Fluent English. Arabic is a plus.

Founded in 1990 as Fawaz Alhokair Fashion Retail Co., Cenomi Retail has introduced more than 80 international retail and F&B brands to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. These include some of the world’s most loved including Zara, Mango, Aldo, Cinnabon, Subway and more. Cenomi Retail operates more than 1,600 stores across 100 shopping centers in 11 countries. We are dedicated to growth and breaking down boundaries to offer a truly unique brand partnership proposition.

Job Purpose: The Store Department Manager is responsible for leading and managing a designated department within the store to achieve sales, profitability, customer service, and operational excellence objectives. The role ensures effective execution of commercial strategies, inventory management, visual merchandising standards, and team performance while delivering an exceptional shopping experience for customers. The position also supports overall store operations and contributes to the achievement of business goals.
q: Deliver a high standard of customer service and ensure exceptional shopping experiences.
Resolve customer complaints and escalated inquiries promptly and professionally.
Ensure customer service initiatives are effectively implemented within the department.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement plans where required.
Oversee daily department operations to ensure smooth and efficient business activities.
Ensure compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures, and operational guidelines.
Conduct regular floor walks to ensure proper product presentation, replenishment, housekeeping, and safety standards.
Support store opening, expansion, relocation, and closure activities when required.
Ensure all assets and company property are protected through proper operational controls.
Monitor stock availability, inventory accuracy, and replenishment activities.
Coordinate stock counts and inventory audits.
Ensure compliance with loss prevention policies and procedures.
Investigate stock discrepancies and take corrective actions.
Maintain optimal inventory levels to maximize sales opportunities while minimizing shrinkage.
Monitor departmental expenses and payroll budgets.
Review sales, margin, and stock performance reports regularly.
Ensure departmental profitability and adherence to approved budgets.
Continuously monitor labor costs and store operational expenses.
Lead, motivate, coach, and develop department employees.
Conduct performance reviews and provide regular feedback.
Identify training and development needs and ensure team capability enhancement.
Participate in recruitment, interviewing, hiring, promotions, disciplinary actions, and workforce planning.
Foster a positive and high-performance work environment.
Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.
Ensure merchandise is displayed according to brand standards and visual merchandising guidelines.
Monitor product presentation, signage, and promotional displays.
Collaborate with Visual Merchandising teams to maximize customer engagement and sales conversion.
Ensure compliance with Saudi labor regulations, company policies, and operational standards.
Maintain health, safety, and security standards within the department.
Support internal and external audits as required.
Promote a culture of compliance and risk awareness.
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or related field preferred.
Diploma or High School Certificate with relevant retail leadership experience may be considered
Minimum 5-8 years of retail experience in Fashion Retail.
At least 3 years in a supervisory, Department Manager, Assistant Store Manager, or similar leadership role.
Experience in international or regional fashion brands is preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint preferred).
Knowledge of retail KPIs and fashion retail operations.
r: Drive departmental sales and achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
Analyze sales reports, KPIs, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and implement corrective actions.
Support the execution of promotional campaigns, seasonal launches, and marketing initiatives.
Monitor product performance and recommend actions to optimize sales and margin.
Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with company promotional guidelines.
Contribute to achieving seasonal and annual sales objectives.
